meta.name: prisma-postgres-setup
meta.description: Obtain or reuse a Prisma Postgres database and connect an application. Use for "set up Prisma Postgres", "connect my app to Prisma Postgres", or Prisma Postgres setup in v0 and Vercel Marketplace. Hands Prisma ORM configuration to prisma-orm-setup; honors an explicit driver, alternative ORM, or database-only choice.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为应用开通云端数据库并接好连接,拿到配置就能开始写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚起步一个项目,需要给应用配一个可用数据库并连上。
copy.tagline_en: Provision a cloud database and wire it into your app so you can start coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're starting a project and need a working database connected to your app.

howto.what: 它会帮你获取或复用一个 Prisma Postgres 数据库,把应用连上去,连接信息存进项目的密钥环境配置,最后用一条只读查询验证连通,并报告连的是哪个库、用了哪个 ORM 和查询结果。
howto.when: 当你说“设置 Prisma Postgres”“把我的应用连到 Prisma Postgres”,或在 v0、Vercel Marketplace 里配置 Prisma Postgres 时接管。

say.text: 帮我设置 Prisma Postgres,并连上我的应用
say.note: 先检查项目,再获取或复用数据库

say.text: 复用我现有的 Prisma Postgres 连接,验证能查通
say.note: 只跑只读查询,不改数据

say.text: 我只要数据库,先别配 ORM

howto.what_en: It obtains or reuses a Prisma Postgres database, connects your app, stores the connection in the project's secret env config, then runs a read-only query to verify and reports what was connected plus the ORM and version.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up Prisma Postgres, connect your app to it, or configure it in v0 or the Vercel Marketplace.

say_en.text: Set up Prisma Postgres and connect my app
say_en.note: Inspects the project, then provisions or reuses

say_en.text: Reuse my existing Prisma Postgres connection and verify a query
I only need the database, skip ORM setup
